newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chung Hwa chairman in share deals.
newsitem.headline: Chung Hwa chairman in share deals.

text.p: Packager Chung Hwa Development Holdings Ltd said on Friday its controlling shareholder and chairman Martin Kwok had placed 50 million shares in the company after buying 38.43 million shares in the open market.

Controlling shareholder Shimada Ltd, which is owned by Kwok, bought 38.43 million shares, or 3.5 percent of Chung Hwa, in the open market at HK$1.55 on January 14, the company said in a statement. Shimada then placed 50 million shares, or 4.6 percent, at HK$1.63 on January 15,
Chung Hwa said following the transactions, Shimada owned 387.59 million shares, or 35.6 percent of the company.
Trading in Chung Hwa shares was suspended on Thursday after rising HK$0.10, or 6.25 percent, to HK$1.70 on Wednesday on heavy trading volume of 125.48 million shares.
Chung Hwa deputy chairman Jenkin Cheung said in the statement that the Securities & Futures Commission was enquiring into the trading of the company's shares.
